pattern.description: A white 'AI agent chain of thought' card pops in top-right, connected to the chat by dashed lines, and grows as four checked steps append one after another, each with a green check icon.
pattern.why_premium: The card scales up in step with the list so the container never shows empty space; rapid ~100 ms stagger reads as the agent reasoning in real time and visualises an abstract claim ('they reason') as concrete steps.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(card, {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.8, transformOrigin: 'left top'}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out'}); tl.fromTo(items, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 10}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.1}, '<0.05'); animate card height with the items (Flip or height: 'auto').
build_hint.remotion: card: spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 140}}) driving opacity and scale 0.8->1; items i: spring({frame: frame - 3*i, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 200}}) for opacity and translateY 10->0; card height interpolated from the visible item count.

notes: Dashed connector lines appear with the card (absent in the first frame of the crop) but have no candidate box; omitted rather than guessing a manual box spanning the card. Whether the card truly scales or only grows in height as rows append is ambiguous from the crops; filmstrip is a zoomed crop.
